remarks: Nestled in the heart of Norwalk, this beautifully maintained townhouse-style condo is a commuter's dream come true. Imagine stepping into a bright, sun-filled space that exudes warmth and charm, where every detail has been thoughtfully upgraded for modern comfort. The second-floor unit on Main Avenue boasts stunning laminate floors, soft new under-cabinet lighting, and a sleek Thermador dishwasher. With a brand-new washer and dryer, a state-of-the-art water heater, and a fresh AC system, every corner is designed for your convenience. Relax and unwind on your private balcony, a peaceful retreat after a long, hectic day. The loft, with its spacious walk-in closet and full bath, offers a perfect blend of comfort and privacy, and the freshly painted walls invite you to make it your own. The Nest thermostat allows you to control your climate with ease, ensuring your home is always at the perfect temperature. No pets, please, as the owner is allergic. This is more than just a place to live-it's the perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience. Welcome home to your ideal escape in the heart of Norwalk, where the perfect balance of serenity and accessibility awaits you.
